title: fix(platform-objects): decide the action body/ai en-echoes per leaf, and close the one-schema-two-forms blind spot
body:
Part of #19403

Clause-②: no

## What this is

Round 5 of this card. One panel family, decided **leaf by leaf**. The deliverable is a per-leaf judgement with its reason recorded, not twelve translations; every leaf below was decided on its own evidence, and the verdicts with their reasons live in a ledger the suite reads (`action-body-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`), not only in this body.

**The family: the five children of `action.fields.body` plus `action.fields.ai`** — the `body` composite on the action metadata form, and the AI-exposure block one section over. Both string leaves of each key are decided.

Not `Fixes` — this is one family of the card's population, and the card outlives this round. **Four families remain** (23 label keys / 39 decidable sibling leaves), tabled at the foot of this body.

## The tie at the top of round 5's table, and how it was broken

Round 4 fixed the sizing rule as **largest by LEAVES**. Re-derived on this branch's base `4045781fa`, two rows tie at 12:

| family | keys | leaves |
|:--|--:|--:|
| **`action.fields.body.*` + `action.fields.ai`** — what this round took | 6 | **12** |
| six bare type-display pairs (`seed`·`mapping`·`api`·`doc`·`book`·`capability`) | 6 | **12** |
| `object.fields.enable.*` (+`validations`) | 9 | 11 |
| `hook.fields.retryPolicy.*` + `body.memoryMb` + `timeoutMs` | 5 | 10 |
| `report.fields.drilldown` + `runtimeFilter` + `sections.dataset_binding` | 3 | 6 |

The tie-break is written into the ledger's header, four reasons, none of them preference:

1. **The instrument survives only one of them.** The card's second property is a population DERIVED from `en` with a dark control. `action` is one panel: one derivation over one metadata type, and the dark control has something to exclude (it asserts `retryPolicy`, `valueDomain`, `drilldown`, `enable` and the `hook` section headings are *not* action leaves). The six type-display pairs are six unrelated types with no panel around them — the derivation degenerates into six one-entry lookups and the control has nothing to be dark about.
2. **Evidence density forces per-leaf work.** Four of the six keys have an authored twin at a byte-identical `en` one metadata type over; one has a twin that is ITSELF an echo; one has no twin at all.
3. **The #19430 trap is live here, on three of the twelve leaves**, and is discharged at the schema below rather than deferred.
4. **Leaving it costs more.** A bare type-display pair has no siblings, so deferring it leaves nothing half-done. Deferring this one leaves the action panel's Behavior and Advanced sections reading half Chinese and half English around a single composite.

## The census — this branch's own reading, base `4045781fa`

| reading | base | this branch |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `en` string leaves / `.label` leaves | 893 / 538 | 893 / 538 — same population |
| label keys echoing in ALL THREE locales | **29** | **23** |
| ⇒ as `.label` leaves | 87 | 69 |
| ⇒ as decidable sibling leaves (label + its `helpText`/`description`) | 51 | 39 |
| POSITIVE CONTROL — labels genuinely translated (`zh-CN`) | 509 | **515** |
| POSITIVE CONTROL (`ja-JP` · `es-ES`) | 493 · 493 | **499 · 499** |

Echoes fall 6 while the control rises 6 in each locale, same population, same run. A parser matching too broadly cannot produce that agreement. **87 and 69 count `.label` leaves; 51 and 39 count decidable sibling leaves** — two questions, two right answers, and this body states which it means at every number.

## The evidence, per key — and the one key that had none

`actionForm` and `hookForm` declare the **same composite over the same schema**: `HookBodySchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts`), five children, identical field names, byte-identical `helpText` sources. So the precedent is not a same-string match found elsewhere in the catalog — it is the other rendering of this very schema key.

| key | evidence | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `body.language` | authored twin, byte-identical `en`, **and it names both tokens** | translate ×3 |
| `body.source` | authored twin; the bare word `Source` has three authored senses in this catalog and the twin picks the code one | translate ×3 |
| `body.capabilities` | authored twin, byte-identical `en`, keeps all four enum members | translate ×3 |
| `body.timeoutMs` | authored twin; the `en` is the extractor's humanize of `timeoutMs`, and the twin renders the concept | translate ×3 |
| `body.memoryMb` | ⛔ **NO TWIN — the hook twin is itself an echo in all three locales.** Composed from the sibling key's authored twin instead, and the row says so | translate ×3 |
| `ai` | no twin of any kind (`hookForm` declares no `ai`); the authored **section description one entry up the same panel** names the concept, the **schema** settles the tokens | translate ×3 |

⭐ **Round 4's lesson, read the other way round.** Round 4 recorded that a precedent answers only the question it actually contains: its twin settled the prose and named no token, so the schema had to settle the tokens. Here the twin settles **both** halves for `language` and `capabilities` — `hook.fields.body.language.helpText` is authored AND names `expression` and `js` AND keeps both English. Same rule, opposite reading: the twin is sufficient *precisely because the question is inside it*. For `ai.helpText` there is no twin at all and only the schema answers. Each row says which half its evidence covers.

⭐ **And one leaf shows why a wholesale answer is refused.** `action.fields.ai.label` reads `Ai` — the extractor's humanize of the two-letter key. The obvious repair is the case fix `Ai` to `AI`, which differs from the source in bytes, **passes the echo predicate in every locale, and tells a zh-CN author exactly as much as the echo did**. Rejected as a phantom translation; the label takes the concept the panel's own authored section description already names, with `es-ES` rendering the acronym `IA` and the other two keeping `AI`, exactly as that description does.

## The #19430 trap was live on three leaves, and every one was read at the schema first

`#19430 is not addressed here` and remains open — this is the discipline it asked for, applied before a word was rendered.

| leaf | tokens named in prose | what the schema says | done |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `body.language.helpText` | `expression`, `js` | the two `z.literal` discriminators of `HookBodySchema` | kept English |
| `body.capabilities.helpText` | `api.read`, `api.write`, `crypto.uuid`, `log` | four of the five `HookBodyCapability` `z.enum` members (`api.transaction` is the fifth and the prose names it not at all) | kept English |
| `ai.helpText` | `ai.exposed=true`, `ai.description` | `ActionAiSchema`'s two canonical keys — a `strictObject` that declares `enabled`/`enable`/`aiEnabled`/`expose`/`visible` as **aliases** of `exposed`, so a rendered spelling is a spelling the schema refuses | kept English |

Also kept: `ctx` and `import` (the sandbox binding and the reserved word `ScriptBodySchema` forbids), and the schema bounds `256` (`.max(256)`) and `40` (`.min(40)`). All of it is **asserted**, not described — a machine-token guard reds when any of them stops being carried verbatim, and ablation C reds it specifically.

## ⭐ The blind spot's FIFTH shape: one schema, two forms, invisible in OPPOSITE ways

Rounds 1–4 measured `record`, `composite`, a pin green one level **up** from what it walks, and a pin's own vacuity control passing **to the side**. This round measured it across two forms.

`repeater-row-properties.test.ts` derives a row property for every child of a `type: 'repeater'` field. Measured on this base:

| form | covered by that pin | invisible to it | state before this round |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `actionForm` | **18** (`params.*`) | **5** (`body.*`, a `composite`) | all 18 authored · all 5 echoing |
| `hookForm` | **0** | **7** (`body.*` + `retryPolicy.*`) | 4 of 5 `body` children authored · `memoryMb` and both `retryPolicy` children echoing |

⇒ the same composite is invisible to the same pin **in two opposite ways**. On `action` it is the **lit** vacuity control `carrying.has('action') === true` that passes — supplied by `params`, the repeater that was never broken (round 4's shape, reproduced). On `hook` it is the **dark** control `carrying.has('hook') === false`, which is **true and correct** — `hookForm` enumerates no repeater at all — while seven children sit enumerated and outside it. A correct control and a passing control produce the same green, and neither can be repaired by deriving harder on one panel.

⭐ **Because the half that matters lives BETWEEN the two derivations.** Before this round `action.fields.body.*` echoed on 5 of 5 children and `hook.fields.body.*` on 1 of 5: the same five schema keys, the same five `en` sources, two different states, and no assertion anywhere that they should agree. This PR adds one — wherever the `hook` twin is authored, `action` renders it identically in every locale — with its own lit control proving it compared real leaves (30 pairs, 6 excluded because `memoryMb` carries no authored twin in any locale), and the exclusion set asserted to be exactly `['memoryMb']`. When the `hook` family lands in a later round, this assertion starts covering `memoryMb` too and reds if that round renders it differently from this one.

`ablation D` is the one worth reading: it makes `action` disagree with its authored twin and **only** that assertion reds. Every echo rule stays green, because the mutated string is not the `en` source.

## The instrument — five independent assertions, proven by four ablations

Mutation, run and restore inside **one** `ablation-replace.mjs` process per ablation. Every restore verified: `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob back to `HEAD`'s, checked independently afterwards as well.

| ablation | what it mutates | reds |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A | a decided leaf reverted to its `en` source in one locale | the enumerated verdict **and** the derived panel pin — **2**, independently |
| B | a provenance row re-pointed at a decided leaf | a **third** — the second witness |
| C | a kept spec key rendered as words | a **fourth** — the machine-token guard |
| D | the `action` rendering made to disagree with its authored `hook` twin | a **fifth** — the new cross-panel invariant, and nothing else |

⇒ 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = **five assertions that fail on five different triggers**, not five spellings of one. All four dark controls carried from the earlier rounds are present and fire: the echo predicate flags all 12 rows when fed `en`; the derived predicate flags all 79 panel leaves when fed `en`; the provenance lookup is proved to be able to say "still a fill", matched by **pattern** so a later round cannot red it by fixing a family; and the machine-token guard's negative uses `api.transaction` — a **real** `HookBodyCapability` member this prose deliberately does not name — so a green cannot come from an `includes` that matches anything.

## ⛔ The silent-loss hazard: values only, measured with a discriminating control

`*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` is generator-owned but `git check-attr merge` reads `unspecified`, so it is NOT routed to `merge=os-regen`. Regenerated with **`pnpm i18n:extract`**, never by hand, and no key was added or removed:

```
en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES:  base 893 keys | head 893 | added 0 | removed 0
values changed per bundle:   en 0 | zh-CN 12 | ja-JP 12 | es-ES 12   (exactly the decided leaves)
provenance rows:             12 removed per locale, 0 added   (exactly the decided leaves)
NEGATIVE CONTROL (drop one key by hand): removed 1 => the comparator CAN see a 1-key delta
```

⚠️ One measurement worth recording: the anchor for `body.memoryMb` occurs **twice** in each translated bundle — once under `action`, once under `hook`, byte-identical — so the edit was scoped to the top-level `action` block and refused on any count other than one. An unscoped replacement would have exited 0 having silently translated a leaf belonging to a family this round does not own.

## The changeset, measured

`@objectstack/platform-objects` has no `private` key and ships `files: ["dist", …]`, and the decided leaves reach `dist` — so `skip-changeset` would be measurably wrong and a **`patch`** changeset is included. Dist probe over all three entry points that carry the catalogs (`index.mjs`, `plugin.mjs`, `metadata-translations/index.mjs`), with controls:

```
zh  内存（MB）  as 内存（MB）   1 1 1      lower-case hex spelling   0 0 0
ja  メモリ（MB） as メモリ（MB）  1 1 1
es  Exposici\xF3n a IA                          3 3 3      lower-case hex spelling   0 0 0
ai.exposed=true kept verbatim                   4 4 4
NEGATIVE CONTROL  raw un-escaped 内存（MB）      0 0 0      raw un-escaped メモリ     0 0 0
NEGATIVE CONTROL  an invented string            0 0 0
```

⇒ the raw un-escaped control reads **0 including for the positive controls**, so a zero here means "escaped", not "absent", and esbuild's UPPER-CASE hex is confirmed by its lower-case spelling reading 0.

## Gates

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` — **48 files / 690 passed** (47/668 on the base: +1 file, +22 tests); `typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm check:i18n` exit 0; repo-wide `pnpm lint` exit 0 at `6f249d952`.
- **Gate reconciliation: 60 derived / 60 run green / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN**, derived with `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` and reconciled with `--ran` carrying every exit code captured **before any pipe**, so the zero is DERIVED rather than claimed.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited **3** — PREREQUISITE NOT MET, 14 packages with no `dist/`. **Discharged, not reported as a 3**: the closure the gate names was built and the gate re-run clean (104 published require entry points across 67 packages, 620 CJS files parsed).
- `origin/main` moved three commits (one of them a `packages/spec` change) while this ran; merged, build state refreshed per AGENTS.md §9, `check:generated` for spec exit 0, the package suite re-run green, and the gate derivation re-taken on the merged tree — **byte-identical**.

## Acceptance notes

Everything below is noted, not filed. This round files **zero cards**, and that is a reading rather than an absence:

- **The known trap was checked, not assumed.** `action.fields.ai.helpText` is the leaf on this panel that could have carried #19430 without a precedent to catch it — no twin exists anywhere in either catalog. It was taken to `ActionAiSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` and read there: two canonical keys, five declared aliases of `exposed`, a `.min(40)` bound. Nothing about it is a defect in this repo's code; it is a leaf that needed a schema read, and got one. ⇒ no card.
- **`hook.fields.body.capabilities.label` reads 功能 / 機能 ("feature") for a value that is a capability TOKEN**, and this round copied that word rather than improving it, because one schema key must have one rendering across the two panels that declare it and rewording it is an edit to the hook family. It is a wording preference on a landed authored string, not a reproducible defect, not a contract violation and not a metadata-authoring trap — none of the three classes. **承接者: the round of this card that takes the `hook` family**, which will hold both panels to whichever word it picks, because the assertion this PR adds makes divergence red.
- **Keys echoing in only one or two locales are outside this card's population by definition** (the card counts the all-three intersection; its own filing note records 83 · 99 · 99 per locale at filing). `object.fields.lifecycle.retention.maxAge.label` is one such: 最长保留 in `zh-CN`, still `Max Age` in `ja-JP` and `es-ES`. Recorded so the next reader does not mistake the intersection for the whole. **承接者: 无** — no queued issue covers it and this round does not widen the card to reach it.
- **A toolchain reading, for whoever runs a closure build next.** `pnpm --filter PKG build --concurrency=2` forwards `--concurrency=2` into each package's build script; tsup ignores it, but `@objectstack/cli`'s shell-script build dies on `sh: 1: Syntax error: word unexpected`. The working spelling is `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=PKG`. Pre-existing tooling behaviour, already documented in the agent rules' toolchain traps, reproduced here as a fact rather than filed. **承接者: 无**.

## What is left — in keys AND leaves, re-measured on this branch

| family | keys | leaves |
|:--|--:|--:|
| six bare type-display pairs (`seed`·`mapping`·`api`·`doc`·`book`·`capability`) | 6 | **12** |
| `object.fields.enable.*` (+`validations`) | 9 | 11 |
| `hook.fields.retryPolicy.*` + `body.memoryMb` + `timeoutMs` | 5 | 10 |
| `report.fields.drilldown` + `runtimeFilter` + `sections.dataset_binding` | 3 | 6 |
| **total** | **23** | **39** |

⇒ as `.label` leaves that same remainder is **69**. The tie at the top is gone: the six type-display pairs are now uniquely largest by leaves. ⚠️ Whoever takes them inherits the warning round 5's order carried — they are a different shape from every family so far, bare `TYPE.label` + `TYPE.description` with no panel around them, so the "authored twin one entry down the same panel" evidence has no analogue there and something must stand in for it. ⚠️ And the `hook` family now carries a second obligation: the cross-panel assertion this PR adds means its `body.memoryMb` rendering must match the one landed here.
